description: This file contains security-related functions for a Python backend, including JWT creation and validation, password hashing, token expiration configuration, and secret management.

methods.name: str _get_jwt_secret()
methods.description: Reads the JWT secret key from environment variables, with fallback and validation.

methods.name: str _get_jwt_algorithm()
methods.description: Reads the JWT algorithm from environment variables, defaults to HS256.

methods.name: int _get_access_token_expires_minutes()
methods.description: Gets the expiration time in minutes for access tokens from environment, defaults to 60.

methods.name: int _get_refresh_token_expires_days()
methods.description: Gets the expiration time in days for refresh tokens from environment, defaults to 14.

methods.name: bool verify_password(plain_password: str, password_hash: str)
methods.description: Verifies a plaintext password against its bcrypt hash.

methods.name: str hash_refresh_token(refresh_token: str)
methods.description: Hashes a refresh token string for storage.

methods.name: bool verify_refresh_token(refresh_token: str, refresh_token_hash: str)
methods.description: Verifies a refresh token against its stored hash.

methods.name: str _create_token(*, subject: str, token_type: str, expires_delta: timedelta, extra: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None)
methods.description: Creates a signed JWT with claims including subject, type, expiration, and optional extras.

methods.name: str create_access_token(*, subject: str, role: Optional[str] = None, expires_minutes: Optional[int] = None)
methods.description: Creates a signed JWT access token with optional role and expiry override.

methods.name: str create_refresh_token(*, subject: str, role: Optional[str] = None, token_version: int = 0, expires_days: Optional[int] = None)
methods.description: Creates a signed JWT refresh token with versioning and optional role.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] decode_token(token: str)
methods.description: Decodes and verifies a JWT token, raising errors if invalid or expired.

methods.name: str extract_subject(token: str)
methods.description: Extracts the 'sub' claim (subject) from a verified token.

methods.name: str extract_token_type(token: str)
methods.description: Extracts the token 'type' claim (access or refresh).

methods.name: Optional[str] extract_role(token: str)
methods.description: Extracts the optional 'role' claim from a verified token.

methods.name: int extract_refresh_token_version(token: str)
methods.description: Extracts the 'ver' claim (refresh token version) from a verified refresh token.

ctags.signature: (*, subject: str, token_type: str, expires_delta: timedelta, extra: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None)

ctags.signature: (*, subject: str, role: Optional[str] = None, expires_minutes: Optional[int] = None)

ctags.pattern: /^def create_refresh_token(*, subject: str, role: Optional[str] = None, token_version: int = 0, ex/
